title: Notifications
summary: An in-app inbox for each person, with email and text message preferences they control.
description: Adds a notification table, an Inbox page with unread counts, mark read and live updates, and a settings page where each person chooses email and text messages. Every new notification lands in the inbox and is emailed (unless the person turned email off); people who opt in to texts get an SMS through your connected Twilio. Staff can send a notification by hand, and any workflow can create one with ctx.db.create("notification", ...).

params.name: recipient_role
params.label: Who receives them
params.description: The role whose people get notifications (their own table is the recipient).

params.name: email_field
params.label: Their email field
params.description: Optional: the email field on that role's table, for the email copy.

params.name: sms_from
params.label: Twilio number
params.description: Optional: your Twilio phone number (E.164, like +15550100). Leave it out and texts stay off.

notes: Text messages need Twilio connected and sms_from set; email and the inbox work without them.

includes: Inbox and settings components with their pages
A staff page to send a notification by hand
Workflows that email and text each notification as the person prefers
highlights: Private: people read only their own notifications
Rule: a notification can be marked read, not edited
